|gr1= Variables

|descr= A non-existent [[Object]]. To compare non-existent objects use [[isNull]] or [[isEqualTo]]:
<sqf>
objNull == objNull;			// false
isNull objNull;				// true
objNull isEqualTo objNull;	// true
</sqf>

|s1= [[objNull]]

|r1= [[Object]]

|x1= <sqf>player == player; // false if player is null</sqf>

|x2= <sqf>isNull player; // true if player is null</sqf>

|x3= <sqf>str objNull // <NULL-object></sqf>

|x4= <sqf>position objNull // [0,0,0]</sqf>
